scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --dir frontend dev" "uv run --project backend python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir backend"
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && uv run --project backend ruff check backend/app backend/tests backend/scripts scripts
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir frontend format:check && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend/app backend/tests backend/scripts scripts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && uv run --project backend mypy backend/app
scripts.test: pnpm --dir frontend test:run && uv run --project backend pytest
scripts.contracts: uv run --project backend python backend/scripts/export_contracts.py && pnpm exec openapi-typescript backend/build/contracts.openapi.json -o frontend/src/types/api.generated.ts
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts && git diff --exit-code -- backend/build/contracts.openapi.json frontend/src/types/api.generated.ts
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && uv run --project backend python -m compileall -q backend/app
scripts.verify: pnpm repo:check && pnpm skills:check && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm build
